draft_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
rationale: The package only reports exp1 (original labels, 5 seeds) in Table T1. There are no noise conditions (10/20/30%), no F1-drop values (0.6/1.3/1.8), and no tests. The cited T2 rows do not exist. The claim is entirely unsupported.
